name: Delicious Crispy Spring Rolls
desc: A deep-fried Liyue snack. With a crisp crack, the juicy filling bursts forth as you bite. Beneath the golden, flaky shell are not only layers of flavor, but the vibrant, bustling spirit of Liyue itself.

value.text: Increases all party members' DEF by 235 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
